installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# PotenFYR Studios Multi-Language Installer
apk add --no-cache curl git ca-certificates
INSTALL_DIR="/mnt/server"
[ ! -d "${INSTALL_DIR}" ] && INSTALL_DIR="${PWD}"
cd "${INSTALL_DIR}" || exit 1
# Git sync rules (mirror of the launcher's sync_git_repo):
#   * trim stray whitespace from panel Startup variables (breaks clones silently)
#   * re-point origin at the CURRENT GIT_REPO/token and reset to FETCH_HEAD
#     (origin/<branch> is stale on single-branch clones and branch switches)
#   * fetch OVER a non-empty workspace instead of failing the clone (no wipe)
#   * print the installed commit so latest-vs-old is verifiable in the console
if [ -n "${GIT_REPO:-}" ]; then
    GIT_REPO=$(printf '%s' "${GIT_REPO}" | tr -d ' \t\r\n')
    GIT_BRANCH=$(printf '%s' "${GIT_BRANCH:-main}" | tr -d ' \t\r\n')
    [ -n "${GIT_BRANCH}" ] || GIT_BRANCH="main"
    GIT_AUTH_TOKEN=$(printf '%s' "${GIT_AUTH_TOKEN:-}" | tr -d ' \t\r\n')
    GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
    export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT
    AUTH_URL="${GIT_REPO}"
    case "${GIT_REPO}" in
        https://*) [ -n "${GIT_AUTH_TOKEN}" ] && AUTH_URL="https://${GIT_AUTH_TOKEN}@${GIT_REPO#https://}" ;;
    esac
    echo "[PotenFYR] Syncing repository (branch: ${GIT_BRANCH})..."
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        git remote set-url origin "${AUTH_URL}" 2>/dev/null || git remote add origin "${AUTH_URL}" 2>/dev/null || true
        if git fetch --depth 1 origin "${GIT_BRANCH}"; then
            git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD || echo "[PotenFYR][!] Fetched but could not apply commits - installed code kept."
        else
            echo "[PotenFYR][!] Git fetch failed - keeping installed code (check URL, branch, token)."
        fi
    elif [ -n "$(find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        echo "[PotenFYR] Workspace has existing files - fetching repository over them (no wipe)..."
        git init -q . 2>/dev/null || true
        git remote remove origin 2>/dev/null || true
        git remote add origin "${AUTH_URL}" 2>/dev/null || true
        if git fetch --depth 1 origin "${GIT_BRANCH}"; then
            git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD || echo "[PotenFYR][!] Fetched but could not apply commits - existing files kept."
        else
            echo "[PotenFYR][!] Git fetch failed - keeping existing files (check URL, branch, token)."
        fi
    else
        git clone --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" --depth 1 "${AUTH_URL}" . \
            || git clone --depth 1 "${AUTH_URL}" . \
            || echo "[PotenFYR][!] Git clone failed - check URL, branch and credentials."
    fi
    COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null) && echo "[PotenFYR][i] Repository at commit ${COMMIT}"
fi
chown -R 988:988 "${INSTALL_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || chown -R 1000:1000 "${INSTALL_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || chmod -R 777 "${INSTALL_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "[PotenFYR][✓] Installation complete. Workspace ready."

variables.name: Target Language
variables.description: Target language or 'auto' for intelligent file auto-detection. After the first boot the detected value is pinned; set to 'auto-detect' to clear the pin and re-run detection.

variables.name: Execution Runner
variables.description: Runner or engine to use (e.g. auto, node, bun, tsx, uvicorn, cargo, go). 'auto' resolves to the effective engine on first boot and is pinned; set to 'auto-detect' to re-arm.

variables.name: Main Entry Point File
variables.description: The main script or file to execute (leave 'auto' for smart detection). 'auto' resolves to the concrete entry point on first boot and is pinned; set to 'auto-detect' to re-arm.

variables.name: Package Manager
variables.description: Package manager for dependency resolution (e.g. auto, npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pip, cargo).

variables.name: Memory Auto Tune
variables.description: Auto-tune GC & memory limits to prevent container OOM (1 = Enabled, 0 = Disabled).

variables.name: Dev Watch Mode
variables.description: Enable watch and hot-reload mode during development (1 = Enabled, 0 = Disabled).

variables.name: Auto Install Dependencies
variables.description: Automatically install missing dependencies on container boot (1 = Enabled, 0 = Disabled).

variables.name: Pre-Run Command
variables.description: Command to execute before starting the main process (e.g. database migrations).

variables.name: Post-Run Command
variables.description: Command to execute when application stops or shuts down.

variables.name: Build Command
variables.description: Optional build or compilation command (e.g. 'npm run build', 'cargo build --release').

variables.name: Clean Build Cache
variables.description: Purge compiler caches after build to save disk space (1 = Enabled, 0 = Disabled).

variables.name: Custom Command
variables.description: Custom command to override the default runner entirely.

variables.name: Custom Install Command
variables.description: Custom dependency install command that replaces the automatic one (e.g. 'bun install', 'pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile'). Leave empty for auto-detection.

variables.name: Extra Arguments
variables.description: Extra CLI arguments passed to the runner or executable.

variables.name: Starter Project Template
variables.description: Starter project template if workspace is empty (e.g. nodejs, bun, python, golang, rust).

variables.name: Auto .env Injector
variables.description: Ensure .env has correct PORT and HOST=0.0.0.0 bindings (1 = Enabled, 0 = Disabled).

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: Git repository URL to clone and sync on startup.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Target branch to clone or track from the Git repository.

variables.name: Git Auth Token
variables.description: Personal Access Token for private Git repositories.

variables.name: Extra Download URLs
variables.description: Additional files or archives to download on boot (URL or dest|URL).

variables.name: Auto Restart
variables.description: Automatically restart process on unexpected crash (1 = Enabled, 0 = Disabled).

variables.name: Restart Delay
variables.description: Delay in seconds before attempting to auto-restart.

variables.name: Assigned Server Port
variables.description: Primary network port allocated by the panel.

variables.name: Extra Runtimes
variables.description: Comma-separated extra toolchains to enable (e.g. 'python,java,go' or 'none').

variables.name: Skip Runtimes
variables.description: Comma-separated runtimes to skip/disable (e.g. 'python,java' or 'none').

variables.name: Runtime Version
variables.description: Version of the primary runtime: 22 | 22.1 | 22.1.4 or keywords latest, stable, lts, alpha, beta, rc, preview, nightly. Validated & resolved from live upstream feeds. 'latest' resolves once, then pins to the exact version; set to 'auto-detect' to re-resolve.

variables.name: Language Version (Alias)
variables.description: DB_VERSION-style alias: pinned version (e.g. 22.1, 3.12, 21) or keywords latest/stable/lts/nightly. Acts as RUNTIME_VERSION fallback.

variables.name: Custom Runtime URL
variables.description: Direct URL to a custom runtime (.tar.gz, .zip or standalone binary) downloaded into the container on boot.

variables.name: Node-gyp Support
variables.description: Install Python 3 + build tools for native node addon compilation (1 = Enabled, 0 = Disabled).

variables.name: Skip Python Companion
variables.description: Prevent the Python companion toolchain from being installed (1 = Skip, 0 = Allow).

variables.name: Debug Output
variables.description: Enable verbose script debug output (1 = Enabled, 0 = Disabled).

variables.name: Supervisor Mode
variables.description: Multi-process mode: auto (Procfile when present + language auto), procfile (force), single (never). Powers multi-layer apps in one container.

variables.name: Procfile Auto-Restart
variables.description: Restart crashed Procfile processes with linear backoff (1 = Enabled, 0 = Disabled). Gives up after 5 attempts per process.

variables.name: Procfile Per-Process Logs
variables.description: Mirror each supervised process stream to .logs/processes/<name>.log (1 = Enabled, 0 = Console only).

variables.name: Health Check Path
variables.description: HTTP path probed after boot (e.g. /healthz). Empty = disabled. Probe targets http://127.0.0.1:$SERVER_PORT<path>.

variables.name: Health Check Strict
variables.description: Exit the server non-zero when the health check fails (1 = Strict, 0 = Warn only).

variables.name: Egg Update URL
variables.description: URL checked on every startup for egg/launcher self-updates. Points at the PotenFYR egg JSON by default; when it changes, the launcher scripts are refreshed automatically. Can also point at a raw .sh URL to update the launcher directly.

variables.name: Auto Update Egg
variables.description: Check EGG_UPDATE_URL on startup and self-update the launcher when the upstream egg changed (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled).

variables.name: CLI Theme
variables.description: Console output theme for the launcher (prog = Prog-Language Eggs agent theme, classic = legacy PotenFYR theme).

variables.name: Panel Stop Watcher
variables.description: Watch console input for the panel stop command (^C, stop, kill...) so Stop works on Wings/Feather-style daemons that send stop as console text (auto = enabled except when stdin must stay with the app; 0 = disabled, 1 = forced on).

variables.name: Banner Gradient
variables.description: Console banner color gradient: auto (random each boot), citrus, aurora, sunset, ocean, candy, spectrum, or none.
